ablation_reference: position_depth: fitted position bucket probabilities, position conditional air means, position depth-completion. Same frozen G YAC in every I model.

bootstrap.confidence: 95% percentile; descriptive, no multiple-comparison-adjusted certainty claim
bootstrap.unit: paired whole games in circular2-calendar/NFL-week moving blocks within season; no row-wise sampling

comparators: Frozen Phase1F scalar efficiency, Phase1G native components, transparent prior8 player-stat YPT. Native F depth/air unavailable: report NA, do not manufacture an air model. Player-history PBP depth/catch/air also provided on same rows.
cutoff: Strictly earlier REG season/week and game date for all rolling QB/receiver/pair/opponent histories. Fitted league/position priors trained only on fit period, never future validation. No target-week passer ID, participation, targets, catches, air or outcomes as feature.

families.depth_catchability: position depth/air reference plus QB/receiver/pair conditional completion and shrunken opponent completion allowed by bucket, catch only
families.opponent_depth_allowance: position reference plus opponent positional target-depth distribution, depth only
families.qb_depth_only: replace depth PMF and conditional air by QB-position history; completion stays position prior
families.qb_receiver_hierarchy: structural required depth ablation, QB then receiver; must improve incrementally versus both marginal ablations to earn hierarchy
families.qb_receiver_pair: required structural depth ablation; pair shrunk toward QB/receiver hierarchy, no pair correction below20 prior targets; must improve incrementally versus hierarchy
families.receiver_depth_only: replace depth PMF and conditional bucket air by receiver shrunken histories; completion stays position prior

fixed_yac: Phase1G frozen selected_config: catch_rate*YAC_per_catch copied unchanged per player row, NEVER multiplied by Phase1I completion. Phase1H YAC corrections forbidden.
mechanics: completed_air_per_target=sum(P_depth[b]*E_air_given_completion_and_bucket[b]*P_completion_given_bucket[b]); totalYPT=completedAirYPT+FROZEN_Phase1G_YAC_YPT. Conditional air uses actual completed PBP air yards. No final-yard regression or Monte Carlo.

metrics.catch_rate_by_depth: bucket conditional absolute error only rows with actual targets in that bucket; report denominators; macro mean across4 buckets
metrics.catch_rate_mae: overall absolute completion probability error vs receptions/targets
metrics.completed_air_per_target_mae: observed completed PBP air / actual targets
metrics.explosive_completed_air_error: 20+ completed-air yards/target MAE and completed20+ target probability MAE
metrics.signed_bias: oracle-target yard prediction minus official yards
metrics.target_depth_distribution_error: mean total-variation distance between predicted4-bucket PMF and observed game target proportions

periods.fit: 2024 W1-8 target plays only; 2023 supplies rolling entity history
periods.refit: selected prior specification on all REG 2024; diagnostic ablations refit at their frozen penalties

population: Frozen Phase1B prior-3 CURRENT-TEAM mean targets>=3, >=2 games. Same paired official-stat rows for all estimators; actual targets>0 for efficiency; component/depth metrics additionally require complete reconciled PBP labels. Missing QB uses disclosed prior fallback, not row deletion.
pressure_blitz: Audited but NOT_TESTED in this isolating experiment; no routed modifier or failed Phase1H coefficients reused.

priors.hierarchy: league -> position -> QB by receiver position -> receiver -> QB/receiver pair; approximate pooled empirical-Bayes parents, overlapping histories disclosed rather than claimed independent evidence
priors.learner: interpretable Dirichlet target-bucket frequencies / Beta depth-completion rates / completed-air sample means; no trees, calibration, final-yard fitting
priors.position: WR/TE/RB shrink toward fitted league with50 target equivalents

qb_assignment.fallback: prior career target-pass count over last3 QB games among current-roster QB identities; if no positive history -> UNKNOWN_PRIOR_QB, disclose cold fallback
qb_assignment.membership: current-team weekly roster QB IDENTITIES only; ignore active/inactive status. Retrospective roster-identity timing assumption exposed, not certified T24/T90 state.
qb_assignment.primary: highest prior-current-team target-pass count over last3 team games, exponential weights 1,0.5,0.25; current-roster membership excludes departed QBs
qb_assignment.uncertainty: retain candidate weights/source; not a dedicated starter model, no actual target-game QB oracle

route_sources: Targeted route labels historical only; complete routes-run, alignment, per-route separation/defender assignment BLOCKED_DATA; do not stall PBP experiment.

selection.combinations: Only development-surviving depth architecture + independently surviving catch and/or opponent-depth family. Fixed preselected modules; no new combination tuning. Required structural hierarchy/pair ablations tested independently, never a failed rich all-feature combination.
selection.config_metric: completedAirYPT MAE, then target-depth TV, oracle-yard MAE, higher shrinkage and deterministic JSON tie breaker
selection.family_gates: >=0.5% completedAirYPT improvement vs position reference; oracle-yard MAE no worse; depth families also>=0.5% TV improvement and deep-frequency error no worse. Catch family also>=0.5% overall and mean bucket catch-rate improvement. Hierarchy additionally requires no worse TV and>=0.5% air improvement vs receiver and QB marginals; pair same vs hierarchy. 2-week paired air bootstrap upper95<0 required.
selection.full_yards: Only after selected candidate passes2025 efficiency, use frozen Phase1E targets and report MAE, within10/20, >40 miss rate, signed bias; otherwise NOT_RUN_EFFICIENCY_GATE_FAILED.
selection.overall_development: Candidate must contain both QB and receiver contributions (hierarchical depth or depth-catchability); >=0.5% oracle-yard improvement vs frozen Phase1F and simple history; >=1% completedAirYPT improvement vs native Phase1G; catch-rate no worse than G; bootstrap upper95<0 for oracle vsF and air vsG. Choose lowest oracle MAE, then fewer modules, name.
selection.validation: Identical efficiency gates on2025 after freeze, plus its claimed depth/catch component gates; no rescue. YAC bit-identical. 2026 cannot promote/rescue.

source_vintage_limit: Completed-game research replay, not literal archived historical provider publication/cutoff equivalence. Frozen source SHA256s must match; no refresh to W5+.
